prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return strict TypeScript module solution.ts.
Required API: export function thresholdStablePartition(input: string): string | null
Behavior: Parse canonical threshold;values, where threshold is one signed integer and values is a non-empty comma-separated list, all in -1000..1000. Return values below threshold in original order followed by values at least threshold in original order, joined by commas. Reject malformed or out-of-range input.
Visible example: 3;5,1,3,2,4 returns 1,2,5,3,4.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: const nums=(s:string):number[]|null=>{if(!s)return null;let o=[];for(const z of s.split(',')){if(!/^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(z))return null;let x=Number(z);if(x< -1000||x>1000)return null;o.push(x)}return o};export function thresholdStablePartition(s:string):string|null{let q=s.split(';');if(q.length!==2)return null;let x=nums(q[0]),y=nums(q[1]);if(!x||!y||x.length!==1)return null;let t=x[0],a=y;return a.filter(x=>x<t).concat(a.filter(x=>x>=t)).join(',')}
